name: Sparse Voxel Surface Regularization
definition: A set of regularizations for surface geometric accuracy refinement that enlarges global geometry consistency constraint for tiny voxels and facilitates reconstructing sharp and accurate surfaces by regularizing voxel-based surface formation.
summary: Sparse Voxel Surface Regularization refines sparse voxel grids via dropout, rectification, and scaling to ensure global geometry consistency and reduce depth bias, outperforming 3D Gaussian Splatting in challenging areas.
